title: Fix Empty Diagram and Csp Block in Mcp App
description: After the scene/model fixes, the diagram is now empty and there is a blocked CSP request. Two bugs: 1) _build_diagram_data in semio/engine/main.py looks up design from kit["designs"] which may be a shallow entry (no pieces) — same root cause as the _enrich_design fix. Pass the full session design to _build_diagram_data. 2) The CSP meta only declares connectDomains/resourceDomains — the MCP host may need additional fields. Investigate and fix both.
summary: Fixed three issues: 1) Empty diagram: _build_diagram_data looked up design from kit["designs"] (shallow, no pieces) — fixed by injecting full session design into kit_for_flatten before calling flattenDesignDict, and added design= param to pass it through from _build_app_payload. 2) CSP block: drei's useGLTF loads Draco decoder scripts from https://www.gstatic.com/draco/ by default — fixed by passing useDraco=false to useGLTF in ScenePieceModel, eliminating the external-origin fetch. 3) TypeScript errors: Design has no variant/view fields, Type has no variant, Connector has no id — removed non-existent fields from KitDesignData/KitKindData Pick<>, buildKitDataFromKit mapping, getKitArtifactHref, and added missing Coord import and name field in test fixtures. Rebuilt dist/mcp-app.html. All 194 semio/ui tests pass.
